title: linearRegression
body:
## linearRegression

Fits an ordinary least-squares linear model (response = intercept + sum of coefficient x predictor) to 1 to 8 numeric predictors with R's stats::lm, then reopens the saved model in a fresh R process and checks every coefficient, prediction and residual against an independent calculation. It publishes coefficients.csv, training.csv, heldout.csv (when held-out rows are given), regression-summary.json and, with optional inference, inference.csv containing standard errors, t statistics, p-values and confidence intervals. Choose it for calibration curves or simple explanatory fits whose error or coefficient limits you can state in advance.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- There must be more training rows than coefficients, and the predictors must not be (nearly) linearly dependent; otherwise INSUFFICIENT_DATA, RANK_DEFICIENT_DATA or ILL_CONDITIONED_DATA.
- Only additive numeric terms: no categorical variables, interactions, polynomials or custom formulas.
- Optional inference assumes independent, constant-variance, normal errors; an exact fit has no residual variance (NO_RESIDUAL_VARIANCE). No causal claims; held-out errors describe only the rows you supplied.
- A correct fit that misses a declared requirement fails with FIT_REQUIREMENT_NOT_MET and is not passed to later workflow steps.

Native binding: `stats::lm / base::saveRDS / stats::predict / stats::summary.lm / stats::confint`. Output kind: `["table","text"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `predictors` | The 1 to 8 explanatory variables, in the order their values appear in every training and held-out row. Each gets one coefficient in the fitted model. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"unit":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true}},"required":true},"minItems":1,"maxItems":8}` | **required** |
| `response` | Observed dependent numeric quantity with a distinct lowercase name and plain unit label. It is the final cell of every training/held-out row. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"unit":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true}}}` | **required** |
| `training` | The 4 to 512 observations used to fit the model; each row lists the predictor values in declared order and then the observed response. The rows must contain more observations than coefficients and enough independent variation in the predictors; a numerical conditioning limit (1e6 after scaling) rejects nearly dependent predictors. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-1000000000.0,"maximum":1000000000.0},"minItems":2,"maxItems":9},"minItems":4,"maxItems":512}` | **required** |
| `heldout` | Optional one to 512 separate observed rows in the same predictor/response order. These finite rows assess declared prediction errors, not future generalisation; no automatic split. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-1000000000.0,"maximum":1000000000.0},"minItems":2,"maxItems":9},"minItems":1,"maxItems":512}` | omitted |
| `intercept` | Include a constant coefficient, default true. Disable only when a zero response at zero predictors is a justified model constraint; training rows must exceed coefficient count. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `true` |
| `inference` | Optional classical inference for the fitted coefficients. When present, regression-summary.json gains standard errors, t statistics, two-sided p-values and confidence intervals for every coefficient, the residual standard error, R-squared, adjusted R-squared and the overall F test, and inference.csv is published last. These quantities are valid only if the additive linear mean is right and the errors are independent, constant-variance and normally distributed; they describe uncertainty in the coefficients, not the spread of future observations. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"level":{"type":"number","minimum":0.5,"maximum":0.999,"default":0.95}}}` | omitted |
| `requirements` | Optional one to 32 named finite fit requirements. Native computation verification comes first; unmet requirements block success and downstream reuse. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":64,"required":true},"scope":{"type":"enum","values":["training","heldout"],"required":true},"metric":{"type":"enum","values":["rmse","maxAbsoluteError","prediction","coefficientInterval"],"required":true},"term":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32},"sampleIndex":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":511},"minimum":{"type":"number","minimum":-1e+18,"maximum":1e+18},"maximum":{"type":"number","minimum":-1e+18,"maximum":1e+18}}},"minItems":1,"maxItems":32}` | omitted |
